```xml
<robot name="desk_154x70x63">
  <!-- Dimensions (metres) -->
  <!-- Width (X): 1.540  -->
  <!-- Depth (Y): 0.630 (front faces -Y, back faces +Y) -->
  <!-- Height (Z): 0.700 -->
  <!-- Top thickness: 0.040 -->
  <!-- Leg thickness (square): 0.060 -->
  <!-- Drawer outer: full width minus margins; depth aligned under top; slides +X? (slides along +/-(Y)?) -->
  <!-- Drawer travel: along Y toward front (-Y) -->
  <!-- Drawer internal depth and clearance simplified -->
  <material name="wood_brown">
    <color rgba="0.55 0.38 0.22 1"/>
  </material>
  <material name="wood_dark">
    <color rgba="0.35 0.25 0.15 1"/>
  </material>
  <material name="wood_light">
    <color rgba="0.65 0.48 0.30 1"/>
  </material>
  <material name="drawer_front">
    <color rgba="0.50 0.34 0.20 1"/>
  </material>

  <!-- ===================== Link definitions ===================== -->

  <!-- Desk top -->
  <link name="top">
    <inertial>
      <!-- Approximate mass and inertia for a rectangular box -->
      <!-- Top: 1.540 x 0.630 x 0.040, placed at z=0.700 - 0.020 = 0.680 -->
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.680" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="12.0"/>
      <inertia
        ixx="0.5*12.0*(0.630*0.630 + 0.040*0.040)/12.0"
        iyy="0.5*12.0*(1.540*1.540 + 0.040*0.040)/12.0"
        izz="0.5*12.0*(1.540*1.540 + 0.630*0.630)/12.0"
        ixy="0" ixz="0" iyz="0"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.680" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.540 0.630 0.040"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_brown"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.680" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.540 0.630 0.040"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Legs (4) -->
  <!-- Leg centers: x = ±(1.540/2 - 0.060/2) = ±0.740 - 0.030 = ±0.710
       y = ±(0.630/2 - 0.060/2) = ±0.315 - 0.030 = ±0.285
       z from floor: leg height to underside top = 0.700 - 0.040 = 0.660
       Leg placed from z=0 to z=0.660, so center z = 0.330
  -->
  <link name="leg_front_left">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0.710 -0.285 0.330" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="2.8"/>
      <inertia
        ixx="0.5*2.8*(0.060*0.060 + 0.660*0.660)/12.0"
        iyy="0.5*2.8*(0.060*0.060 + 0.660*0.660)/12.0"
        izz="0.5*2.8*(0.060*0.060 + 0.060*0.060)/12.0"
        ixy="0" ixz="0" iyz="0"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.710 -0.285 0.330" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.060 0.060 0.660"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.710 -0.285 0.330" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.060 0.060 0.660"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <link name="leg_front_right">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="-0.710 -0.285 0.330" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="2.8"/>
      <inertia
        ixx="0.5*2.8*(0.060*0.060 + 0.660*0.660)/12.0"
        iyy="0.5*2.8*(0.060*0.060 + 0.660*0.660)/12.0"
        izz="0.5*2.8*(0.060*0.060 + 0.060*0.060)/12.0"
        ixy="0" ixz="0" iyz="0"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="-0.710 -0.285 0.330" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.060 0.060 0.660"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.710 -0.285 0.330" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.060 0.060 0.660"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <link name="leg_back_left">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0.710 0.285 0.330" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="2.8"/>
      <inertia
        ixx="0.5*2.8*(0.060*0.060 + 0.660*0.660)/12.0"
        iyy="0.5*2.8*(0.060*0.060 + 0.660*0.660)/12.0"
        izz="0.5*2.8*(0.060*0.060 + 0.060*0.060)/12.0"
        ixy="0" ixz="0" iyz="0"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.710 0.285 0.330" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.060 0.060 0.660"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.710 0.285 0.330" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.060 0.060 0.660"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <link name="leg_back_right">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="-0.710 0.285 0.330" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="2.8"/>
      <inertia
        ixx="0.5*2.8*(0.060*0.060 + 0.660*0.660)/12.0"
        iyy="0.5*2.8*(0.060*0.060 + 0.660*0.660)/12.0"
        izz="0.5*2.8*(0.060*0.060 + 0.060*0.060)/12.0"
        ixy="0" ixz="0" iyz="0"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="-0.710 0.285 0.330" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.060 0.060 0.660"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.710 0.285 0.330" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.060 0.060 0.660"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Drawer outer frame (fixed carcass/bottom for collisions) -->
  <!-- We'll model a simple fixed frame: a back plate and side/bottom pieces under top
       Drawer cavity opening: roughly between legs and under top.
  -->
  <link name="drawer_carcass">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.375" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="3.5"/>
      <inertia
        ixx="0.5*3.5*(0.600*0.600 + 0.120*0.120)/12.0"
        iyy="0.5*3.5*(1.440*1.440 + 0.120*0.120)/12.0"
        izz="0.5*3.5*(1.440*1.440 + 0.600*0.600)/12.0"
        ixy="0" ixz="0" iyz="0"/>
    </inertial>

    <!-- approximate collisions as three boxes: back panel, floor, and side supports -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.375" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.440 0.600 0.120"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_light"/>
    </visual>

    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.390" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.440 0.600 0.030"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0.285" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.440 0.030 0.120"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.440 0.600 0.030"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Drawer sliding body -->
  <!-- Drawer geometry -->
  <!-- Outer width in X: 1.540 - 0.100 = 1.440 -->
  <!-- Drawer height in Z: 0.120 (front panel included) -->
  <!-- Drawer depth in Y: 0.500 (fits in cavity depth; opening faces front (-Y)) -->
  <!-- Carcass opening center Z: ~0.375 -->
  <!-- Drawer slides along Y toward front (-Y).
       Define joint axis along Y. We'll set initial drawer at y=+0.055 (more back), and allow to slide -0.110.
       Drawer base frame origin located at its center when y=0? We'll place link origin at drawer center at nominal y=0 and use joint to move in Y.
  -->
  <link name="drawer">
    <inertial>
      <!-- Drawer outer box: 1.440 x 0.500 x 0.120 -->
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.390" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="4.2"/>
      <inertia
        ixx="0.5*4.2*(0.500*0.500 + 0.120*0.120)/12.0"
        iyy="0.5*4.2*(1.440*1.440 + 0.120*0.120)/12.0"
        izz="0.5*4.2*(1.440*1.440 + 0.500*0.500)/12.0"
        ixy="0" ixz="0" iyz="0"/>
    </inertial>

    <!-- Whole drawer outer shell collisions/visuals simplified as a box; add a front panel thickness for realism -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.390" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.440 0.500 0.120"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="drawer_front"/>
    </visual>

    <!-- Drawer outer collisions -->
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.390" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.440 0.500 0.120"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <!-- Front panel (slightly thicker) -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 -0.250 0.390" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.440 0.010 0.120"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_brown"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 -0.250 0.390" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.440 0.010 0.120"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <!-- Handle approximation as small protrusion -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 -0.255 0.395" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.020 0.030 0.020"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_light"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 -0.255 0.395" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.020 0.030 0.020"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- ===================== Joints ===================== -->

  <!-- Fixed base: origin on floor under middle -->
  <!-- Attach legs and top and drawer carcass to base with fixed joints -->
  <link name="base_link"/>

  <joint name="joint_top_fixed" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base_link"/>
    <child link="top"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="joint_leg_front_left_fixed" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base_link"/>
    <child link="leg_front_left"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="joint_leg_front_right_fixed" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base_link"/>
    <child link="leg_front_right"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="joint_leg_back_left_fixed" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base_link"/>
    <child link="leg_back_left"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="joint_leg_back_right_fixed" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base_link"/>
    <child link="leg_back_right"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="joint_drawer_carcass_fixed" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base_link"/>
    <child link="drawer_carcass"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Drawer slides along Y axis (toward front is -Y) -->
  <!-- Joint origin at drawer nominal center position when joint position=0 -->
  <!-- Drawer link collision/visual are defined with origin at its local center but placed at z=0.390.
       We'll set fixed x,z by joint pose and allow Y to translate by prismatic joint.
       Put joint so drawer starts partially retracted: y = +0.055 (back) -->
  <joint name="joint_drawer_slide" type="prismatic">
    <parent link="drawer_carcass"/>
    <child link="drawer"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0.055 0.0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="0 1 0"/>
    <limit lower="-0.110" upper="0.000" effort="50" velocity="1.0"/>
    <dynamics damping="2.0" friction="0.3"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Adjust drawer Z placement via link geometry; drawer link inertial/visual are at z=0.390 in its local frame.
       Since joint origin uses z=0, drawer local z=0.390 is relative to carcass frame; carcass link has inertial at z=0.375 but no transform.
       We must align carcass and drawer properly with fixed transforms by placing carcass at same global as drawer local expectations.
       To ensure drawer sits under top consistently, we set drawer_carcass link geometry with implicit z offsets and rely on link origins.
       Here, base_link origin is global; carcass has collision/visual with z around 0.390 and drawer link likewise. -->
</robot>
```
